howItFalls: A Cesgranrio, em provas bancárias, apresenta um texto em inglês sobre economia, finanças, tecnologia ou comportamento do consumidor, seguido de questões A–E em inglês. O padrão é bem regular: uma pergunta de ideia principal, uma ou duas de informação explícita (“According to the text…”), uma de referência pronominal, uma de vocabulário em contexto e, às vezes, uma de conectivo ou de tempo verbal. Um item típico pergunta a que se refere “this” em determinado parágrafo, e o distrator aponta o substantivo imediatamente anterior, quando o pronome retoma a ideia inteira da frase anterior. Outro exemplo é a pergunta sobre o sentido de “figures” em texto financeiro: quem pensa em figuras erra, porque ali significa números, dados. A profundidade é intermediária, com vocabulário do mundo bancário e digital (fintech, savings, loans, fees, mobile banking). Os distratores misturam palavras do texto em frases que dizem outra coisa. Pesa menos a gramática pura, e quase nunca aparece tradução literal de trechos longos.
tips: Construa um glossário de termos financeiros em inglês: loan, debt, interest rate, savings, fee, revenue, figures.
Em “According to the text”, localize o trecho e confira cada palavra da alternativa.
Lembre que “this” e “that” podem retomar uma ideia inteira, não apenas um substantivo.
Para ideia principal, escolha a alternativa que abrange o texto todo, não um parágrafo.
Desconfie de alternativas que copiam palavras do texto em ordem diferente.
traps: “Figures, no texto financeiro, significa ilustrações” → no contexto econômico figures são números → o sentido é dados, cifras.
“This retoma o substantivo imediatamente anterior” → pode retomar a ideia da frase inteira → leia a frase anterior completa.
“Fees são lucros do banco” → fees são tarifas cobradas → lucro seria profit ou earnings.
“A ideia principal é o exemplo do segundo parágrafo” → um exemplo é detalhe de apoio → a ideia principal cobre o texto inteiro.

questions.statement:
"Green finance in the rainforest" — Banks operating in the Amazon region are increasingly expected to show that their loans do not finance illegal deforestation. Regulators now require lenders to check whether rural properties overlap with protected areas or embargoed land before releasing credit. Although these checks add costs, they also reduce the risk of reputational damage and of default caused by environmental fines. Some analysts argue that the next step should be to reward borrowers who restore degraded areas, offering them lower interest rates. However, such incentives will only work if monitoring data are reliable and easily shared among institutions.

According to the text, before releasing rural credit, banks must

options.text: restore degraded land themselves.
share their profits with regulators.
stop lending to farmers in the region.
offer lower interest rates to all borrowers.
options.comentario: That is a proposal, not a requirement.

options.text: verify whether the property overlaps protected or embargoed areas.

questions.explanation: "Regulators now require lenders to check whether rural properties overlap with protected areas or embargoed land". Pegadinha: Confundir a sugestão de analistas com exigência regulatória.

questions.statement:
Read the text. "Open banking, open questions" — Open banking allows customers to share their financial data with third-party providers through secure application programming interfaces. Supporters argue that the model increases competition, since smaller firms can offer tailored products based on a fuller picture of a client's finances. A borrower who has always paid bills on time, for instance, might obtain a lower interest rate even without a long credit history. Critics, however, warn that consent screens are often too long and too technical, so many users click "accept" without understanding what they are authorizing. Regulators have responded by requiring that data sharing be limited in time and revocable at any moment. Whether these safeguards will be enough remains to be seen, but one point is already clear: the success of open banking will depend less on technology than on trust.

According to the text, supporters of open banking believe that it

options.text: guarantees lower interest rates to all borrowers.
options.comentario: The text says a good payer "might" obtain lower rates.

options.text: replaces credit history with technical consent screens.
options.comentario: Consent screens are criticized, not a credit substitute.

options.text: prevents smaller firms from accessing financial data.
eliminates the need for consent from customers.
options.comentario: The text discusses consent screens; nothing says consent is eliminated.

options.text: fosters competition by allowing firms to design customized products.

questions.explanation: The second sentence states the supporters' view: more competition, because smaller firms can tailor products. Modal verbs like "might" signal possibility, not guarantee. Pegadinha: Treating "might obtain a lower rate" as a guarantee.

questions.statement:
"APIs and open banking" — Application programming interfaces (APIs) have become the backbone of open banking. They allow authorized third parties to access account information or initiate payments, always with the customer's consent. For banks, exposing APIs can be both a threat and an opportunity: competitors may use the data to offer better products, but banks themselves can build partnerships and reach new customers. Nevertheless, APIs must be carefully secured, since a single vulnerability could expose sensitive data from millions of users.

According to the text, third parties may access account data

options.text: without any restriction.
only with customer consent.
only if they are banks.
after paying the customer.
by hacking APIs.

questions.explanation: Alternativa B. O texto diz que as APIs permitem a terceiros autorizados acessar informações ou iniciar pagamentos "always with the customer's consent". O consentimento do cliente é a base do open banking; não há acesso irrestrito nem restrito apenas a bancos. Pegadinha: —

questions.statement:
"Cloud adoption in banking" — Many banks are moving critical workloads to the cloud to gain flexibility and speed up the launch of new services. Yet migration is not simply a matter of copying systems from one place to another. Legacy applications often need to be redesigned, and security responsibilities must be clearly divided between the bank and the cloud provider. Regulators also demand that institutions keep control over their data and maintain contingency plans in case a provider fails. Banks that treat the cloud as a strategic shift, rather than as a cost-cutting trick, tend to achieve better results.

The main purpose of the text is to

options.text: advertise a specific cloud provider.
argue that legacy systems are better.
describe how to copy files.
criticize regulators for blocking cloud adoption.
explain that cloud migration in banks requires planning, redesign and governance.

questions.explanation: Alternativa E. O texto explica que migrar para a nuvem não é só copiar sistemas: exige redesenhar aplicações legadas, dividir responsabilidades de segurança com o provedor e atender exigências regulatórias de controle e contingência. Não há propaganda de fornecedor nem crítica aos reguladores. Pegadinha: —

questions.statement:
Read the text. — Financial inclusion has advanced quickly in emerging economies, largely because of mobile phones. In many regions where bank branches are scarce, people now open accounts, receive wages and pay bills without ever visiting an agency. Yet access is not the same as use. Surveys show that a significant share of new account holders leave their accounts inactive after the first months, either because fees seem unclear or because they do not trust digital transactions. Experts therefore argue that technology must be combined with financial education and transparent pricing. Otherwise, the number of accounts may grow while the real benefits for low-income families remain limited.

According to the text, mobile phones have

options.text: helped people access banking services where branches are scarce.
options.comentario: "where bank branches are scarce, people now open accounts".

options.text: eliminated fees on digital accounts.
reduced trust in digital transactions.
options.comentario: Lack of trust is a cause of inactivity, not a result of phones.

options.text: increased the number of bank branches.
replaced financial education in emerging economies.
options.comentario: The text says technology must be combined with education.

questions.explanation: The second sentence explains how phones expanded access. Main idea and supporting details must be distinguished. Pegadinha: Choosing an option that mixes words from different sentences.

The sentence "Yet access is not the same as use" introduces

options.text: a conclusion about fees.
a definition of inclusion.

questions.explanation: Nessa frase, "Yet" é conector adversativo, equivalente a "however" ou "but". Ele contrapõe o avanço do acesso às contas, dito antes, ao fato de que elas não são efetivamente usadas. A frase não define inclusão nem traz conclusão sobre tarifas; apenas abre o contraste que o texto desenvolve em seguida. A armadilha é ler "yet" no sentido temporal de "ainda". questions.explanation: "Otherwise" significa "caso contrário", ou seja, "se isso não acontecer". Por isso, equivale a "If not". O sentido é: sem educação financeira e preços transparentes, os benefícios continuarão limitados. "Therefore" indica conclusão, "moreover" indica adição e "meanwhile" indica simultaneidade. A armadilha é confundir "otherwise" com "therefore". Pegadinha: Confusing with "therefore".
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
Read the text. — Financial inclusion has advanced quickly in emerging economies, largely because of mobile phones. In many regions where bank branches are scarce, people now open accounts, receive wages and pay bills without ever visiting an agency. Yet access is not the same as use. Surveys show that a significant share of new account holders leave their accounts inactive after the first months, either because fees seem unclear or because they do not trust digital transactions. Experts therefore argue that technology must be combined with financial education and transparent pricing. Otherwise, the number of accounts may grow while the real benefits for low-income families remain limited.

According to experts, the real benefits of inclusion depend on

options.text: reducing the number of accounts.
banning digital transactions.
increasing fees.
more bank branches only.
combining technology with financial education and transparent pricing.

questions.explanation: O texto afirma que os especialistas defendem combinar tecnologia com educação financeira e preços transparentes ("technology must be combined with financial education and transparent pricing"). Sem isso, o número de contas cresce, mas os benefícios reais ficam limitados. Nenhum trecho propõe reduzir contas, proibir transações digitais ou depender apenas de mais agências. Pegadinha: —
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
The city library will open one hour earlier on weekdays beginning in June. Weekend hours will remain unchanged, and the children’s room will still close at 6 p.m.

According to the notice, what will change in June?

options.text: The library's weekday opening time.
The library's closing time every day.
The schedule of the children's room on weekends.
The number of books available for borrowing.
The library's weekend opening time.

questions.explanation: O aviso informa expressamente que a biblioteca abrirá uma hora mais cedo nos dias úteis. Os horários do fim de semana não serão alterados, e nada se afirma sobre acervo ou sobre mudança do encerramento diário.
questions.section: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência

questions.statement:
Mara submitted her application on Monday. By Thursday, she had received no confirmation, although two colleagues who applied later had already heard back. She decided to contact the admissions office.

What can reasonably be inferred about Mara?

options.text: She knows that her application has been rejected.
She is concerned about the lack of confirmation.
She applied after both of her colleagues.
She plans to withdraw her application immediately.
She received a confirmation but lost the email.

questions.explanation: A decisão de contatar o setor, após observar respostas a candidatos posteriores, sugere preocupação com a ausência de confirmação. O texto não permite concluir rejeição, desistência nem recebimento prévio de mensagem.
questions.section: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência

questions.statement:
A recent survey of 600 commuters found that most respondents valued reliable bus arrivals more than free onboard Wi-Fi. The survey did not ask whether they would be willing to pay higher fares for improved service.

Which conclusion is supported by the survey?

options.text: All commuters would accept a fare increase.
Wi-Fi access was considered useless by every respondent.
Respondents placed greater value on punctual buses than on free Wi-Fi.
Higher fares are necessary to improve arrival times.
The survey established the views of every commuter in the city.

questions.explanation: O levantamento identifica uma preferência relativa pela confiabilidade dos ônibus em comparação ao Wi-Fi gratuito. Não investigou disposição para pagar mais, tampouco autoriza generalizar a todos os usuários da cidade.
questions.section: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência

questions.statement:
To reduce food waste, the cafeteria now serves smaller standard portions but allows customers to request a second helping at no extra charge. Staff say that fewer plates return with uneaten food.

What is the main idea of the passage?

options.text: The cafeteria has removed second helpings from its menu.
Customers must pay more to receive enough food.
Staff are required to weigh all returned plates.
A change in portion policy is associated with less discarded food.
The cafeteria has stopped serving standard portions.

questions.explanation: A ideia central liga porções iniciais menores, com repetição gratuita disponível, à diminuição das sobras relatada pela equipe. As demais afirmações contradizem a política descrita ou acrescentam exigências inexistentes.
questions.section: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência

questions.statement:
Although the company expanded its online store last year, most of its sales still came from physical locations. Managers expect digital sales to grow, but they have not announced plans to close any shops.

Which statement best reflects the passage?

options.text: Online sales were the company's only source of income.
All physical stores are scheduled to close.
The online store was abandoned after its launch.
Management confirmed a date for closing the shops.
Physical stores remained the leading sales channel last year.

questions.explanation: O contraste introduzido por 'although' indica que a expansão digital não tirou das lojas físicas a liderança nas vendas. A expectativa de crescimento on-line não equivale a um anúncio de encerramento das unidades.
questions.section: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência

questions.statement:
During the pilot program, employees could choose to work remotely on Fridays. Participation was optional, and workers in customer-facing roles needed their supervisors' approval before joining.

Who could participate without first obtaining the specific approval mentioned?

options.text: Eligible workers who were not in customer-facing roles.
Every employee who served customers in person.
Only employees who had worked remotely before.
Anyone willing to work from home all week.
No employee, because participation was mandatory.

questions.explanation: O requisito explícito de autorização do supervisor recai sobre quem exerce atendimento ao público. Para os demais, o texto não impõe essa aprovação específica; participar era opcional e limitado às sextas-feiras.
questions.section: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência

questions.statement:
After a series of delays, the research team released preliminary findings rather than its full report. The authors stressed that the figures might change once the remaining data were checked.

What should readers avoid assuming?

options.text: That some data still need checking.
That the preliminary figures are final.
That the full report has not yet been released.
That the team acknowledged possible revisions.
That the reported findings are preliminary.

questions.explanation: Os pesquisadores apresentam resultados preliminares e avisam que os números podem mudar após a conferência dos dados restantes. Tratá-los como definitivos ignora essa ressalva; as demais leituras são expressamente sustentadas.
questions.section: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência

questions.statement:
Students who missed the first workshop may watch a recording before attending the second session. However, the recording does not replace the short assessment required of all participants.

A student who missed the first workshop must still

options.text: attend a new first workshop in person.
pay a fee to access the recording.
complete the short assessment.
skip the second session altogether.
submit a second recording of the workshop.

questions.explanation: O texto afirma que a gravação pode ajudar quem faltou, mas não dispensa a avaliação exigida de todos. Não há previsão de taxa, reapresentação presencial da primeira oficina ou impedimento à segunda sessão.
questions.section: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência

questions.statement:
The committee described the proposal as 'feasible', provided that the existing staff could be trained within three months.

In this context, 'feasible' is closest in meaning to

options.text: mandatory.
unpopular.
already completed.
practicable.
financially profitable.

questions.explanation: 'Feasible' qualifica algo que pode ser realizado, sob a condição de capacitação da equipe. O termo não expressa obrigação, rejeição, execução concluída nem lucratividade, sentidos que dependeriam de outras informações.
questions.section: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões

questions.statement:
The editor asked the journalist to 'look into' the discrepancy between the two figures before publishing the article.

The expression 'look into' means to

options.text: ignore.
translate.
illustrate.
approve without checking.
investigate.

questions.explanation: No contexto de divergência entre números, 'look into' significa examinar ou investigar o problema. A orientação ocorre antes da publicação e não se confunde com ignorar, traduzir, ilustrar ou aprovar sem conferir.
questions.section: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões

questions.statement:
The manager said that the new office would 'eventually' accommodate all regional teams, even though only one department would move there this year.

The word 'eventually' indicates that the move will happen

options.text: at some point in the future.
by chance and without planning.
only if an emergency occurs.
immediately after the announcement.
occasionally, but never on a regular basis.

questions.explanation: 'Eventually' indica um resultado esperado em algum momento futuro, não 'eventualmente' no sentido de possibilidade ocasional. A mudança parcial neste ano reforça a realização gradual, sem afirmar acaso ou urgência.
questions.section: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões

questions.statement:
The company issued a 'comprehensive' guide covering recruitment, onboarding, payroll and workplace safety.

In the passage, 'comprehensive' suggests that the guide is

options.text: difficult to obtain.
wide-ranging.
brief and incomplete.
strictly confidential.
written only for financial experts.

questions.explanation: A enumeração de diferentes assuntos mostra que 'comprehensive' significa abrangente. O adjetivo não indica sigilo, dificuldade de acesso, brevidade ou restrição a especialistas em finanças, sentidos não apoiados pelo contexto.
questions.section: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões

questions.statement:
During the negotiations, both sides agreed to 'meet halfway' on the delivery schedule instead of insisting on their original deadlines.

The expression 'meet halfway' conveys the idea of

options.text: ending the negotiation without agreement.
sharing a ride to the delivery site.
making mutual concessions.
meeting at the midpoint of a route.
allowing only one side to impose its deadline.

questions.explanation: 'Meet halfway' é expressão idiomática para chegar a um compromisso com concessões recíprocas. A referência aos prazos originais afastados impede a leitura literal de encontro geográfico ou imposição unilateral.
questions.section: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões

questions.statement:
The applicant was asked to provide 'actual' expenses for the trip, not rough estimates prepared before departure.

The adjective 'actual' refers to expenses that were

options.text: expected next year.
updated every hour.
approved in advance.
really incurred.
unrelated to the journey.

questions.explanation: 'Actual expenses' são gastos efetivamente realizados, em oposição às estimativas anteriores à viagem. O falso cognato não significa simplesmente 'atuais' ou atualizados; tampouco pressupõe aprovação antecipada.
questions.section: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões

questions.statement:
The consultant warned that cutting the training budget could 'backfire' if avoidable mistakes later became more frequent.

Here, 'backfire' means to

options.text: guarantee immediate savings without side effects.
increase the number of training sessions.
make a policy legally unenforceable.
delay a plan without affecting its results.
produce an outcome opposite to what was intended.

questions.explanation: 'Backfire' descreve efeito contraproducente: a economia pretendida pode gerar mais erros e custos indiretos. Não significa assegurar poupança, aumentar treinamentos nem apenas retardar a execução da medida.
questions.section: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões

questions.statement:
The supervisor called the intern's suggestion 'sensible' because it reduced unnecessary steps without adding risks.

In this passage, 'sensible' is best understood as

options.text: reasonable.
highly emotional.
easily offended.
physically sensitive.
unrelated to practical judgment.

questions.explanation: 'Sensible' caracteriza a proposta como razoável e prudente, pois reduz etapas sem elevar riscos. Em português, a semelhança com 'sensível' pode induzir erro, mas o contexto trata de julgamento prático.
questions.section: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões

questions.statement:
When the auditors arrived, the finance team had already corrected the spreadsheet.

What does the past perfect indicate?

options.text: The correction will occur after the auditors leave.
The correction preceded the auditors' arrival.
The auditors corrected the spreadsheet themselves.
Both actions necessarily took place at the same instant.
The finance team had not begun the correction.

questions.explanation: O past perfect em 'had already corrected' marca uma ação concluída antes de outro ponto passado, a chegada dos auditores. Não transfere a correção aos auditores nem indica simultaneidade ou ação futura.
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
Employees must wear identification badges in the laboratory, but they may leave them in their lockers when working in the public reception area.

What distinction do the modal verbs establish?

options.text: An obligation to wear badges in every part of the building.
A prohibition against storing badges in lockers.
A requirement in one location and permission in another.
A mere suggestion to wear badges in the laboratory.
A statement that no identification rules exist.

questions.explanation: 'Must' impõe o uso de crachá no laboratório, enquanto 'may' concede permissão para deixá-lo no armário na recepção pública. Confundir obrigação com sugestão ou permissão com proibição distorce a regra.
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
If the supplier delivers the parts by Friday, the engineers will finish the prototype next week.

The sentence presents completion next week as

options.text: guaranteed regardless of the supplier's actions.
an event that was completed last week.
impossible even if the parts arrive in time.
dependent on delivery by Friday.
dependent on the engineers having finished yesterday.

questions.explanation: O primeiro condicional relaciona uma condição possível no futuro — entrega até sexta — ao resultado previsto na semana seguinte. A frase não assegura o resultado incondicionalmente nem descreve fato consumado.
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
The software may have deleted the temporary files during the update. The support team is still checking the logs.

What degree of certainty does 'may have deleted' express?

options.text: Proof that deletion definitely occurred.
A command to delete the files now.
A promise that no files were removed.
An ability that the software will acquire later.
A possibility concerning a past event.

questions.explanation: 'May have' seguido de particípio indica possibilidade relativa a fato passado, não certeza. A análise dos registros ainda em curso confirma a cautela; o enunciado tampouco expressa ordem ou promessa.
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
The new policy was introduced in April. It was revised two months later because several employees found its instructions unclear.

To what does the pronoun 'It' refer?

options.text: The new policy.
April.
The employees.
Two months.
The instructions alone.

questions.explanation: O pronome 'It' retoma 'the new policy', que foi implementada e, posteriormente, revisada. A referência coesiva é singular e compatível com o objeto de revisão; mês e empregados não exercem esse papel.
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
Had the technician checked the connection earlier, the outage might have been avoided.

The sentence implies that

options.text: the connection was definitely checked before the outage.
the technician did not check the connection early enough.
the outage will certainly be avoided tomorrow.
the technician has no responsibility for checking connections.
the outage was impossible under any circumstances.

questions.explanation: A inversão 'Had ... checked' equivale a 'If ... had checked', formando condição hipotética sobre o passado não realizado. 'Might have been avoided' aponta possibilidade, não garantia de evitar a falha.
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
The board has been reviewing the proposal since January, but no final decision has been made.

Which interpretation is consistent with the verb forms?

options.text: The review ended before January.
The board made a final decision in January.
The review began in January and remains relevant now.
The board will start its first review next year.
The proposal has already been permanently rejected.

questions.explanation: O present perfect continuous com 'since January' indica atividade iniciada naquele mês e com continuidade ou efeito no presente. A voz passiva negativa informa que ainda não houve decisão final.
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
The maintenance window was extended; therefore, customers could not access the platform until 3 a.m.

The connector 'therefore' signals

options.text: an example unrelated to maintenance.
a contrast with the preceding statement.
a correction denying that maintenance occurred.
a consequence of the extended maintenance window.
a condition under which maintenance would be canceled.

questions.explanation: 'Therefore' introduz consequência lógica: a ampliação da manutenção explica a indisponibilidade até as três horas. Não sinaliza oposição, exemplo, negação do evento anterior ou condição hipotética.
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
Our town has plenty of parking spaces. What it lacks is a safe way for children to walk to school. Before building another car park, we should repair the sidewalks.

What is the writer's primary purpose?

options.text: To list the town's parking fees.
To describe a completed road repair project.
To announce a ban on children walking to school.
To prove that no resident uses a car.
To argue for prioritizing sidewalk repairs.

questions.explanation: O autor contrasta a oferta de estacionamento com a falta de segurança para pedestres e defende consertar calçadas antes de ampliar vagas. Trata-se de argumentação propositiva, não anúncio de obras concluídas.
questions.section: 4. Organização discursiva, propósito, tom e figuras de linguagem

questions.statement:
The new filing system was advertised as 'effortless'. After three hours of resetting passwords and calling support, the staff finally managed to log in.

The quotation marks around 'effortless' help create a tone of

options.text: irony.
admiration without reservation.
formal celebration.
complete indifference.
scientific neutrality about the system.

questions.explanation: As aspas em 'effortless', contrastadas com as horas gastas em problemas de acesso, produzem ironia sobre a promessa de facilidade. Não se trata de elogio literal nem de relato neutro sem avaliação implícita.
questions.section: 4. Organização discursiva, propósito, tom e figuras de linguagem

questions.statement:
First, the report outlines the causes of urban flooding. It then examines three engineering solutions and ends by comparing their costs and environmental impacts.

How is the report organized?

options.text: From a personal anecdote to a fictional ending.
From causes to solutions and then comparison.
From financial results to a list of employee benefits.
From legal penalties to unrelated historical dates.
From conclusions directly to an unexplained quotation.

questions.explanation: Os marcadores 'First', 'then' e 'ends' descrevem uma sequência clara: causas, possíveis soluções e comparação de impactos. As outras estruturas introduzem tópicos ou gêneros que o excerto não apresenta.
questions.section: 4. Organização discursiva, propósito, tom e figuras de linguagem

questions.statement:
'The deadline is approaching like a train with no brakes,' the project leader said as the team prepared for the final review.

The comparison suggests that the deadline feels

options.text: distant and unlikely to matter.
easy to postpone without consequences.
fast-approaching and difficult to stop.
literally connected to railway scheduling.
irrelevant because the review was canceled.

questions.explanation: A comparação explícita com um trem sem freios reforça urgência e sensação de avanço inevitável do prazo. É linguagem figurada, não referência a uma ferrovia ou prova de que o encontro foi cancelado.
questions.section: 4. Organização discursiva, propósito, tom e figuras de linguagem

questions.statement:
Some critics say that online meetings always reduce collaboration. Yet, several teams in our study reported more frequent exchanges after introducing short daily video calls.

What is the function of 'Yet' in the passage?

options.text: To add another example supporting the critics' absolute view.
To mark the final step in a set of instructions.
To introduce the cause of the critics' opinion.
To introduce evidence that challenges the preceding claim.
To restate the same claim with stronger wording.

questions.explanation: 'Yet' estabelece contraposição entre a alegação absoluta dos críticos e relatos que não a confirmam. O conectivo introduz evidência contrária, sem provar que todas as reuniões virtuais sejam benéficas.
questions.section: 4. Organização discursiva, propósito, tom e figuras de linguagem

questions.statement:
This guide is intended for first-time users. It explains how to create an account, set a password and locate the main settings menu. Advanced integrations are covered in a separate manual.

Who is the intended audience of this guide?

options.text: Developers configuring advanced integrations only.
Customers filing a complaint about service charges.
Auditors examining financial statements.
Users who already know every system function.
People beginning to use the system.

questions.explanation: O guia declara ser voltado a 'first-time users' e aborda operações iniciais de cadastro e configuração. Integrações avançadas estão em outro manual; o público-alvo não são apenas profissionais especializados.
questions.section: 4. Organização discursiva, propósito, tom e figuras de linguagem

questions.statement:
Reducing paper use will not solve every environmental problem in the office. Nevertheless, it is an inexpensive first step that staff can take immediately.

Which description best fits the author's stance?

options.text: Supportive but aware of the measure's limitations.
Dismissive of every attempt to reduce paper use.
Convinced that paper reduction solves all environmental issues.
Uncertain whether staff can act without major investment.
Opposed to immediate low-cost environmental actions.

questions.explanation: O autor reconhece que a medida não resolve todos os problemas, mas a recomenda como começo barato e imediato. O tom é favorável e ponderado; não há rejeição da iniciativa nem promessa de solução integral.
questions.section: 4. Organização discursiva, propósito, tom e figuras de linguagem

questions.statement:
The first paragraph presents a question about declining customer satisfaction. The next two paragraphs analyze survey responses, while the final paragraph proposes changes to support procedures.

The final paragraph mainly serves to

options.text: introduce an entirely new topic with no connection to the survey.
recommend actions based on the preceding analysis.
repeat the original question without responding to it.
replace the survey findings with a fictional story.
explain how the survey sample was first selected.

questions.explanation: A organização enunciada culmina em recomendações para o atendimento após análise dos questionários. Assim, o parágrafo final transforma o diagnóstico em propostas, e não abre tema desvinculado ou apenas repete a questão.
questions.section: 4. Organização discursiva, propósito, tom e figuras de linguagem

questions.statement:
IT NOTICE: Scheduled maintenance will take place on Sunday from 01:00 to 03:00 UTC. Users may experience intermittent access during this window. No action is required before maintenance begins.

What should users understand from the notice?

options.text: All users must reinstall the software before Sunday.
Access will certainly be unavailable for the entire day.
Service access may be unstable during the specified period.
The maintenance will begin at 03:00 UTC.
Users must submit a support request in advance.

questions.explanation: O aviso aponta manutenção entre 01h e 03h UTC e possibilidade de acesso intermitente nesse intervalo. Não prevê indisponibilidade durante todo o domingo nem exige reinstalação ou providência antecipada.
questions.section: 5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questions.statement:
PROCUREMENT NOTE: Quotations must include delivery fees and remain valid for at least 30 days. Proposals received after 5 p.m. on 12 August will not be evaluated.

Which quotation meets the stated formal conditions?

options.text: One that excludes shipping but remains valid for 60 days.
One that includes shipping but expires after 20 days.
One that meets all price conditions but arrives on 13 August.
One that includes shipping, is valid for 35 days and arrives before the deadline.
One that omits the validity period and arrives on time.

questions.explanation: A cotação aceita precisa informar frete, valer pelo menos 30 dias e chegar até o prazo indicado. A proposta com 35 dias, entrega incluída e envio tempestivo atende aos três requisitos simultaneamente.
questions.section: 5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questions.statement:
HELP DESK RULE: Priority 1 incidents involve a complete outage of a critical service. A single user's inability to print while all shared services are running is classified as Priority 3.

How should the printing problem described be classified?

options.text: As Priority 1 because any printing failure is critical.
As an incident with no classification at all.
As Priority 1 whenever the user is a manager.
As a complete outage of all critical shared services.
As a Priority 3 incident.

questions.explanation: A regra distingue interrupção integral de serviço crítico, de prioridade 1, de falha individual de impressão com serviços compartilhados operantes, classificada como prioridade 3. Cargo do usuário não é critério mencionado.
questions.section: 5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questions.statement:
HR MEMO: Staff members may carry over up to five unused vacation days into the next calendar year, provided that their managers approve the request by 15 December.

Under the memo, carrying over vacation days requires

options.text: managerial approval by the stated date.
automatic transfer of all unused days.
a minimum of six unused days.
approval only after the new year begins.
proof that the employee worked on every weekend.

questions.explanation: A transferência é limitada a cinco dias e condicionada à aprovação da chefia até 15 de dezembro. O verbo 'may' não torna o benefício automático; também não impõe mínimo de seis dias nem exigências de fins de semana.
questions.section: 5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questions.statement:
SECURITY GUIDELINE: Password-reset links expire 20 minutes after issuance. If a link has expired, request a new one; do not reuse the old message.

What is the recommended procedure after expiration?

options.text: Try the expired link repeatedly until it works.
Request another password-reset link.
Send the old link to a colleague for activation.
Turn off account security checks permanently.
Assume the account is deleted and cannot be recovered.

questions.explanation: A diretriz determina solicitar novo link quando o anterior expira após 20 minutos, sem reutilizar a mensagem antiga. Insistir no link vencido ou repassá-lo não corresponde ao procedimento indicado.
questions.section: 5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questions.statement:
PROJECT UPDATE: Testing cannot start until the revised specifications are approved. The design team submitted the revisions yesterday; approval is still pending.

Which project activity is currently blocked?

options.text: The submission of the revised specifications.
The initial preparation of the design team's revisions.
The start of testing.
The act of requesting approval in the future.
The completed approval of the revised specifications.

questions.explanation: O início dos testes depende da aprovação das especificações revisadas, que ainda está pendente. A equipe já enviou as revisões; portanto, não é a submissão que permanece impedida, mas a etapa de testes.
questions.section: 5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questions.statement:
DATA POLICY: Archived records are available to authorized staff for audit purposes. Employees must not download copies to personal devices, even when they have permission to view the records.

Which action complies with the policy?

options.text: An authorized employee saves the records on a private laptop.
Any visitor downloads the records to review them at home.
An employee shares archived copies through a personal account.
An authorized employee views archived records for an audit without personal downloads.
A staff member treats viewing permission as unrestricted copying permission.

questions.explanation: A norma permite consulta aos registros arquivados por pessoas autorizadas para fins de auditoria, mas veda downloads em aparelhos pessoais. Permissão de visualizar não se transforma em autorização irrestrita de copiar.
questions.section: 5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questions.statement:
SERVICE AGREEMENT: The provider will acknowledge support tickets within four business hours. Resolution times depend on the incident category and are specified in a separate schedule.

What does the four-business-hour commitment cover?

options.text: Final resolution of every incident within four hours.
Automatic closure of tickets that remain unanswered.
An obligation to resolve all incidents on the same calendar day.
A guarantee that response and resolution are identical steps.
Acknowledgment of a support ticket, not necessarily its resolution.

questions.explanation: O prazo de quatro horas úteis refere-se ao reconhecimento do chamado ('acknowledge'), não à solução definitiva. Os prazos de resolução variam por categoria e estão em outro quadro, que não foi reproduzido.
